# Carlos Alves Consulting

> Automating weekly reports, dashboards and forecasts for UK hospitality and health & wellness operators — built in your spreadsheets, no subscriptions.

Independent Data & AI Consultant helping UK catering and hospitality businesses and health & wellness businesses replace retyped weekly reports, with reporting automation built in your spreadsheets. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute Weekly-Report Walkthrough.
